what_this_is: A deterministic bookkeeping and integration model. It assembles, for every state of the frozen 196-state environment and for each supply mode, the per-state record of the selected architecture from the admitted layers (environment, intake / feed, Hall, RF/ICP, power, thermal, drag, mass), propagates their fail-closed statuses, and integrates the per-state rates over a registered mission mode / state schedule into mission totals (time, propellant, atmospheric gas, electrical energy, impulse, AO fluence) with exact time and propellant accounting. It contains no new device physics: every rate comes from a subsystem layer or is NOT_EVALUATED.
what_this_is_not: not a requirement assessment: no RFP threshold, margin, PASS / FAIL, COMPLY or HC verdict; HC-05 / HC-07 / HC-08 / HC-11 and the 1.5 kW / 40 kg / 12 mN / 25 mN comparisons belong to SC-WP-11 (A9.24 items 3, 5; A9.30)
not a Hall model: Hall quantities come only from an ADMITTED transport member with a design-specific Hall map, or a measured H-1 record; the credible set is EMPTY
not an RF/ICP model: I_e,cap and ICP loads come from NP-ICP-NEUTRALIZER once admitted; M_n is not formed here (GR-18 EX-05)
not an orbit propagation: altitude is a state coordinate of the frozen environment; mission_env.propagate (SC-WP-09 existing-physics element) is not called in v1 (MS-05)
not a mission prediction while no mission schedule is registered: every schedule-integrated total is NOT_EVALUATED today
not a choice of Xe load: the 2 / 5 / 10 kg planning cases are carried together as PARAMETRIC_PLANNING_CASE, none selected (GR-15)
not a port of abep_sim/mission5.py, mission_uq.py, transient.py or radiation.py (class H; GR-06 excluded_legacy_not_ported); nothing is taken from them

implementation_gate.rule: No NP-MISSION-INTEGRATION Rust code before this preregistration (prereg_v1.json, PREREG.md, prereg_lock_v1.json) is committed in its own commit (A9.29 sec. 13; GR-01 sec. 12 'Preregister before implementation').

The verification cases, conservation criteria and fail-closed tests below are fixed now; they are run once for the verification report after implementation and never relaxed after results are seen (CC-03).

architecture_scope.text: Configuration hall_icp_neutralizer only (GR-17). Any other configuration id is refused (MODEL_ERROR).

Supply modes AIR_PRIMARY and XE_CONTINGENCY, both represented (GR-06 a9_29_chain propellant_modes_rule). They are separate modes, never premixed (GR-11 S9.10 OD6; GR-01 OQ-CHEM-10): a schedule segment has exactly one mode; a mixed or unknown mode is refused (OUT_OF_DOMAIN). A third segment mode NON_FIRING represents propulsion-off time (coast / standby); it is not a supply mode.

Flight conventional hollow cathode: NONE (GR-12, GR-13). No cathode field, load, propellant line or event exists in the model; C1 Xe lines are GROUND_REFERENCE_ONLY and never enter a flight ledger. Cathode vocabulary in an input record is refused (MODEL_ERROR).

ICP gas routing is a registered input icp_gas_mode in {G-REUSE, G-ATM, G-XE} (GR-14). G-REUSE (registered primary) feeds the ICP from Hall exhaust / residual gas: it adds no draw on any reservoir. G-ATM draws the ICP dedicated flow from the delivered atmospheric gas; G-XE draws it from the Xe tank. G-ATM in XE_CONTINGENCY has no registered routing: INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE.

derivation_rules.rule: A DERIVED sum or difference: status = worst of the operands (SP-01); value = the f64 operation in the registered order, only if every operand is EVALUATED; reasons = union of the operand reasons.

Parametric layer of a DERIVED quantity: formed only when every operand has an EVALUATED value or a parametric value and at least one operand is parametric; value = the same operation on (value or parametric value); label PARAMETRIC (or the single contributing label when all parametric operands share one); basis lists the contributing labels. Never formed when any operand has neither.
SF-03 and SF-04 are products of EVALUATED environment values (rho * V, n_O * V), evidence_class model-derived, source the design-state set sha256 and state id.
No derived quantity is compared with zero, a requirement or a threshold.

schedule_semantics.rule: A schedule is an ordered list of segments {segment_id (unique, non-empty), mode in {AIR_PRIMARY, XE_CONTINGENCY, NON_FIRING}, state_id (a member of the frozen set), duration_h (finite, > 0)}. During a segment the per-state rates of (state_id, mode) apply unchanged (piecewise-constant integration).

Events are {event_id (unique), segment_id (existing), kind in {START_ATTEMPT}, count (integer >= 0), xe_kg_per_event (Quantity), atm_kg_per_event (Quantity)}; they book discrete propellant use (e.g. the S9.9 OD5 start sequence). No default count or mass exists.

Time accounting (exact): sum of duration_h over all segments == H_M exactly; sum over firing segments (mode != NON_FIRING) == H_F exactly; H_AIR + H_XE == H_F exactly. Sums use exact accumulation (EX-ACC). A violation means the schedule does not realise mission_scenario_v2: the whole integration is OUT_OF_DOMAIN (GR-06 gate 'scenario outside mission_scenario_v2'). Durations must therefore be exactly representable binary64 values.

A segment with an unknown or mixed mode, a non-member state, a duplicate id, a non-finite or non-positive duration, or an event naming an unknown segment is refused: OUT_OF_DOMAIN for mode / state / duration, MODEL_ERROR for identity defects.
No schedule registered: every schedule-integrated total is NOT_EVALUATED with reason MISSION_SCHEDULE_NOT_REGISTERED and carries no value; statewise records and envelopes are still produced.

The schedule is the only source of time weights. The model never weights states by itself (GR-11 S9.7: the states carry no time weights) and never multiplies a rate by H_M or H_F except inside the registered parametric bound PB-AO.

equations.notation: k: schedule segment; s_k, m_k, dt_k [h]: its state, mode and duration; S = 3600 s / h; q(s, m): a per-state rate quantity

items.name: segment contribution
items.form: c_k = q(s_k, m_k) * (dt_k * S)
items.note: operation order fixed: seconds first, then the product (one rounding each)

items.name: schedule integral
items.form: Q = sum_k c_k, accumulated exactly (EX-ACC); reported value = faithful rounding of the exact sum

items.name: time totals
items.form: H_sched = sum dt_k; H_fire = sum_{m_k != NON_FIRING} dt_k; H_AIR = sum_{m_k = AIR_PRIMARY} dt_k; H_XE = sum_{m_k = XE_CONTINGENCY} dt_k; H_coast = H_sched - H_fire (exact)

items.name: Xe consumption
items.form: M_xe,cont = integral of mdot_xe_tank_kg_s (EQ-02, all segments); M_xe,ev = sum_events count * xe_kg_per_event (each product one rounding, exact accumulation); M_xe = M_xe,cont + M_xe,ev

items.name: Xe tank ledger
items.form: m_xe,end = m_xe,0 - M_xe (exact accumulation; reported faithfully rounded); m_xe,usable,end = m_xe,end - m_xe,reserve - m_xe,residual (raw; may be negative; no comparison)

items.name: Xe planning-case ledgers
items.form: EQ-05 evaluated for every registered planning case m_xe,0 in xe_planning_cases_kg, labelled PARAMETRIC_PLANNING_CASE, all cases reported, none selected; formed only when M_xe has an EVALUATED or parametric value

items.name: wet mass
items.form: m_wet,0 = m_dry + m_xe,0; m_wet,end = m_dry + m_xe,end

items.name: atmospheric gas throughput (not stored; no tank, NIR-07)
items.form: M_atm,del = integral of mdot_atm_delivered_kg_s over AIR_PRIMARY segments; M_atm,cons = integral of mdot_atm_consumed_kg_s; M_atm,ev = sum_events count * atm_kg_per_event; M_atm,bal = M_atm,del - M_atm,cons - M_atm,ev (exact accumulation)

items.name: electrical energy
items.form: E_bus = integral of P_bus_W over all segments [J]

items.name: impulse
items.form: J_T = integral of thrust_N; J_D = integral of drag_total_N; J_net = integral of t_minus_d_N, all segments [N s]

items.name: AO fluence
items.form: Phi_AO = integral of ao_flux_m2_s over all segments [m-2]

items.name: statewise envelopes (no schedule)
items.form: for every field and mode: n_states, status counts, worst status; min / max and their state ids over the 196 states only when every state has an EVALUATED value (ties: first in file order); a parametric envelope separately when every state has a value or a parametric value

items.name: parametric bound PB-AO
items.form: [min_s ao_flux, max_s ao_flux] * (H_M * S), label PARAMETRIC_BOUND, basis 'bounds Phi_AO for every schedule whose segments use states of the frozen set; the states carry no time weights (GR-11 S9.7)'; evidence status of Phi_AO stays NOT_EVALUATED (MISSION_SCHEDULE_NOT_REGISTERED) while no schedule is registered. Formed only when every state's ao_flux is EVALUATED.

equations.EX-ACC: exact accumulation: Shewchuk error-free two-sum expansions (J. R. Shewchuk, Adaptive precision floating-point arithmetic and fast robust geometric predicates, Discrete Comput. Geom. 18, 1997; verify); the sum of the non-overlapping components from the smallest to the largest magnitude is the reported (faithfully rounded) value; equality tests (SCH-03, CONS) compare exact expansions

status_propagation.rule: Severity order MODEL_ERROR > OUT_OF_DOMAIN > NOT_EVALUATED > INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE > EVALUATED. A combined status is the most severe contributor; every contributor reason is kept (field, state, mode, segment tags); nothing is dropped.

NOT_EVALUATED / INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE / OUT_OF_DOMAIN / MODEL_ERROR inputs are never turned into numbers: no zero fill, no default, no interpolation across states, no carry-forward of a neighbouring state's value (GR-01 sec. 12).

A schedule integral takes the worst status over its contributing segments (NOT_APPLICABLE fields contribute nothing); its value exists only if every contribution is EVALUATED; its parametric layer follows DR-02 over the contributions.
An environment state whose execution is not EVALUATED gives every ENV / DERIVED field of that state its status and reason.

Determining-evidence gates (GR-06): credible Hall set EMPTY -> Hall-dependent INPUT fields NOT_EVALUATED (reason CREDIBLE_HALL_TRANSPORT_SET_EMPTY); NP-ICP-NEUTRALIZER not admitted -> I_ecap_A and ICP flows NOT_EVALUATED (reason NP_ICP_NOT_ADMITTED) whatever the crate status; Xe load not frozen -> m_xe_loaded NOT_EVALUATED (reason XE_LOAD_NOT_FROZEN); host drag ICD absent -> drag_body NOT_EVALUATED; schedule outside mission_scenario_v2 -> OUT_OF_DOMAIN.

The integration-level status is the worst of: the time-accounting result, the schedule validity, and (for each total) its own status; the record also reports per-total statuses separately so that one NOT_EVALUATED total does not hide an EVALUATED one.

conservation.criterion: time accounting closes exactly: exact(sum dt_k) - H_M == 0, exact(sum firing dt_k) - H_F == 0, exact(H_AIR + H_XE - H_fire) == 0, exact(H_coast + H_fire - H_sched) == 0

Xe ledger closes exactly: exact(m_xe,0 - M_xe,cont - M_xe,ev - m_xe,end) == 0 (expansion arithmetic); and the reported values satisfy |m_xe,0 - M_xe - m_xe,end| <= 1 ulp(max(|m_xe,0|, |M_xe|, |m_xe,end|)) evaluated exactly
wet mass: exact(m_wet,0 - m_wet,end - M_xe) == 0 when all terms are EVALUATED (same rule for every planning case)
atmospheric gas: exact(M_atm,del - M_atm,cons - M_atm,events - M_atm,bal) == 0
status / record conservation: the record holds every state of the frozen set exactly once per mode (196 x 3), in file order; every input reason appears in the record
integral linearity: for a rate constant over all segments, Q == q * (H * S) exactly when q * (H * S) is exactly representable

It is the hook of the decisive architecture run; it fills nothing that the layers do not supply.

assumptions.text: Piecewise-constant integration: the per-state rates hold over a schedule segment (SCH-01). Transients inside a segment are represented only through registered events.
The frozen 196-state set is the registered mission environment; altitude is a state coordinate. No orbit decay or altitude evolution is integrated (MS-05).
Atmospheric gas is not stored (NIR-07: ambient-air storage is not in this RFQ revision); only its throughput is integrated.

model_scope_notes.text: A9.31 sec. 18 Q3 asks for I_d, I_e,cap and M_n. The record carries raw I_d_A and I_ecap_A; M_n is formed by assessment (GR-18 EX-05), never here.
Xe consumption arises only from Xe-mode (or G-XE) segment durations of a registered schedule plus registered events. There is no code path forming Xe flow x H_M or Xe flow x H_F (GR-01 sec. 12).
PB-AO is the only schedule-free bound: AO exposure acts over all mission time, which is registered (H_M). No firing-time bound is formed because H_AIR and H_XE are not registered.
Uncertainty: the model is deterministic. Each Quantity carries its registered uncertainty; propagation across samples / members is SC-WP-10 (U-02 analogue of NP-THERMAL).
mission_env.propagate (PARITY-C-ABEP_SIM_MISSION_ENV_PY-PROPAGATION-V1) needs thrust and host drag, both NOT_EVALUATED; coupling it is a v2 question (OQ-MI-04).

domains.rule: states: members of the frozen set v2 only; other ids OUT_OF_DOMAIN

analytic_limiting_cases.rule: Software verification criteria (CI_PLAN principle 9). Every vector is SYNTHETIC_TEST_DATA_NOT_EVIDENCE. Synthetic states are ids of the frozen set with synthetic rates unless stated.

cases.tolerance: exact (bit pattern) where the closed form is exactly representable, else <= 1 ulp of the correctly rounded rational value

cases.tolerance: <= 1 ulp of the correctly rounded rational value

one segment NOT_EVALUATED among EVALUATED; then that segment parametric

every (mode, icp_gas_mode) cell of R-XE and R-ATM with EVALUATED, NOT_EVALUATED and parametric operands

evidence_validation_plan: Mission integration is bookkeeping; it has no measurable output of its own. Its outputs become evidence-qualified only as their inputs do: an admitted Hall member and map (or measured H-1), admitted NP-ICP, a host-spacecraft drag ICD, a frozen Xe load and CBE masses, and a registered mission schedule (mission ICD / owner record). Until then validation_status = NOT_VALIDATED and every dependent total stays NOT_EVALUATED.
